meta.description: Spain NPK recommendations for 12 crops (16 records; wheat/barley/durum wheat split rainfed-irrigated; olive per-tree + per-ha) - user-supplied data (2026-10-13) with Spanish research sources (MAPA, ITACyL, IFAPA, CITA, AIMCRA, IRTA). All source values already per-hectare.

records.applicationTiming: Basal full P/K + 20% N; top-dress (cobertera) at tillering and stem elongation.
records.applicationMethod: Abonado de fondo: full P2O5 and K2O plus 20% N at sowing. Top-dress (cobertera) N at tillering and stem elongation.
records.notes: N 50-80, P2O5 30-45, K2O 25-40 kg/ha. Soft wheat rainfed (trigo blando secano).
records.source_org: MAPA (Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentacion)

records.applicationTiming: Basal full P/K + 20% N; top-dress (cobertera) at tillering and stem elongation.
records.applicationMethod: Abonado de fondo: full P2O5 and K2O plus 20% N at sowing. Top-dress (cobertera) N at tillering and stem elongation.
records.notes: N 140-190, P2O5 60-80, K2O 60-80 kg/ha. Soft wheat irrigated (trigo blando regadio).
records.source_org: MAPA (Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentacion)

records.applicationTiming: P/K at sowing; single cobertera N at end of winter.
records.applicationMethod: P2O5 and K2O at sowing; single cobertera N top-dress applied at end of winter.
records.notes: N 40-70, P2O5 25-40, K2O 20-35 kg/ha. Barley rainfed (cebada secano).

records.applicationTiming: P/K at sowing; cobertera N at end of winter.
records.applicationMethod: P2O5 and K2O at sowing; cobertera N applied at end of winter.
records.notes: N 110-150, P2O5 50-65, K2O 40-60 kg/ha. Barley irrigated (cebada regadio).

records.applicationTiming: Starter N-P at planting; remaining N fertigated/side-dressed at V6 and V10.
records.applicationMethod: Starter N-P band at planting; remaining N injected via fertigation or side-dressed at V6 and V10 stages. P2O5 and K2O basally.
records.notes: N 200-260, P2O5 70-100, K2O 90-130 kg/ha. Irrigated grain maize (maiz regadio, Ebro/Castilla).
records.source_org_2: MAPA (Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentacion)

records.notes: N 30-50, P2O5 25-40, K2O 20-35 kg/ha. Rainfed sunflower (girasol secano).

records.applicationTiming: Fertigated from spring leaf development to pit hardening; foliar K in autumn.
records.applicationMethod: Intensive drip-irrigated orchard per-hectare dose. Fertigated from spring leaf development to pit hardening; foliar potassium in autumn.
records.notes: N 80-120, P2O5 30-40, K2O 100-150 kg/ha. Intensive olive orchard (olivo, fertirrigacion).
records.source_org: IFAPA (Instituto de Investigacion y Formacion Agraria y Pesquera de Andalucia)

records.applicationTiming: Per-tree dose applied in spring; traditional rainfed orchards.
records.applicationMethod: Source-faithful per-tree dose: N 400-800 g, P2O5 150-250 g, K2O 500-900 g per mature tree per year. Numeric per-hectare values estimated at ~100 trees/ha standard density; always state the per-tree dose first. Applied in spring.
records.notes: N 400-800 g, P2O5 150-250 g, K2O 500-900 g per mature tree/year (olivo tradicional).
records.source_org: IFAPA (Instituto de Investigacion y Formacion Agraria y Pesquera de Andalucia)

records.applicationTiming: Late N cobertera at heading essential for vitreous endosperm.
records.applicationMethod: Basal P2O5 and K2O; N top-dressed with late cobertera at heading essential for vitreous endosperm index and protein.
records.notes: N 80-120, P2O5 40-60, K2O 30-50 kg/ha. Durum wheat high-rainfed (trigo duro secano alto, Andalucia).

records.applicationTiming: Late N cobertera at heading essential for vitreous endosperm.
records.applicationMethod: Basal P2O5 and K2O; N top-dressed with late cobertera at heading for protein and vitreousness.
records.notes: N 150-190, P2O5 40-60, K2O 30-50 kg/ha. Durum wheat irrigated (trigo duro regadio).

records.applicationTiming: Basal P/K; single winter-end N top-dress.
records.applicationMethod: P2O5 and K2O basally; single N top-dress at end of winter.
records.source_org: MAPA (Ministerio de Agricultura, Pesca y Alimentacion)

records.applicationTiming: Single cobertera N at winter-spring transition.
records.applicationMethod: Suited to poor soils. Single cobertera N top-dress at the winter-spring transition.

records.applicationTiming: Full P/K at bed preparation; N split between sowing and 6-8 leaves.
records.applicationMethod: Full P2O5 and K2O at bed preparation; N split between sowing and the 6-8 leaf stage.
records.notes: N 120-160, P2O5 60-80, K2O 140-190 kg/ha. Irrigated sugar beet (remolacha azucarera regadio).
records.source_org: AIMCRA (Asociacion de Investigacion para la Mejora del Cultivo de la Remolacha Azucarera)

records.applicationTiming: 50% N + full P/K basal; 50% N side-dressed/fertigated through tuber bulking.
records.applicationMethod: 50% N plus full P2O5 and K2O basally; remaining 50% N side-dressed or fertigated through tuber bulking.
records.notes: N 140-190, P2O5 80-110, K2O 160-240 kg/ha. Irrigated potato (patata de regadio).

records.applicationTiming: 1/3 basal; 2/3 fertigated during floral squaring and early boll development.
records.applicationMethod: One-third N plus all P2O5 and K2O basally; remaining two-thirds N fertigated during floral squaring and early boll development.
records.notes: N 120-160, P2O5 50-70, K2O 60-90 kg/ha. Irrigated cotton (algodon regadio, Guadalquivir).

records.applicationTiming: Basal incorporated before flooding; top-dressed at tillering and panicle initiation.
records.applicationMethod: Basal incorporated before flooding; N top-dressed at tillering and panicle initiation.
records.notes: N 120-150, P2O5 40-60, K2O 40-60 kg/ha. Rice (arroz, Marismas del Guadalquivir / Delta del Ebro).
